commands.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=00fc889905c05e35c76dd07050edc561b5ef6262; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes; git checkout work/phase1-live-call-probes; git reset --hard origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; MODEL=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); API=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r'); echo MODEL=$MODEL; echo API=$API; test "$MODEL" = SM-S906B; test "$API" = 36; CALL_STATES_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -o 'mCallState=[0-9]' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ $//'); echo CALL_STATES_BEFORE="$CALL_STATES_BEFORE"; test "$CALL_STATES_BEFORE" = 'mCallState=0'; BT_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '\r'); echo BLUETOOTH_BEFORE=$BT_BEFORE; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A | grep -q '[s]hizuku_server'; test -f "$APK"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r "$APK" >/tmp/aicall-install.log; cat /tmp/aicall-install.log; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG"; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.DiagnosticProbeActivity" --ez run_production_media_off_call_smoke true >/tmp/aicall-am-start.log; cat /tmp/aicall-am-start.log; PASS=0; for i in $(seq 1 80); do adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S' > /tmp/aicall-offcall.log; if grep -q 'production_media_off_call_smoke=PASS' /tmp/aicall-offcall.log; then PASS=1; break; fi; if grep -q 'production_media_off_call_smoke=FAIL\|diagnostic_probe_error=' /tmp/aicall-offcall.log; then break; fi; sleep 0.25; done; cat /tmp/aicall-offcall.log; test "$PASS" = 1; grep -q 'reason=expected_off_call_start_rejection' /tmp/aicall-offcall.log; ! grep -q 'unexpected_active_off_call' /tmp/aicall-offcall.log; sleep 1; CALL_STATES_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -o 'mCallState=[0-9]' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ $//'); echo CALL_STATES_AFTER="$CALL_STATES_AFTER"; test "$CALL_STATES_AFTER" = 'mCallState=0'; BT_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '\r'); echo BLUETOOTH_AFTER=$BT_AFTER; test "$BT_AFTER" = "$BT_BEFORE"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A | grep -q '[s]hizuku_server'; ! adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A | grep -q '[c]all_media'; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo s22_offcall_regression_green=true
